section.title: Inattentive Driving Warning
section.p: Driver Attention Warning monitors your driving pattern while driving. When the driver’s attention level is below a certain level, Driver Attention Warning recommends a break to help with safe driving.

section.title: Leading Vehicle Departure Alert function
section.p: Leading Vehicle Departure Alert function will inform the driver when a detected vehicle in front departs from a stop.

li.p: Always keep the front view camera in good condition to maintain optimal performance of Driver Attention Warning.
